content: {"praised":["Well-crafted, intelligent war movie with gritty, personal storytelling.","Features a Bible‑to‑toting soldier hero, unique war film angle.","Strong pacing, especially in the second half of the film.","Classic war film qualities with emotional depth and moral themes.","Engaging setting during the Battle of the Bulge, true‑event based."],"criticized":["Boring, with cardboard characters lacking depth.","Plot full of holes and logic inconsistencies.","Poor acting and weak dialogue throughout.","Shoddy directing and one‑dimensional performances.","British accent and character portrayal criticized as unrealistic."]}
